Institutional Profile

Built around regulated financial-market activities.

Nuvama Wealth Management Limited operates across wealth management, asset management and capital-markets businesses. The institutional profile below presents its business capabilities and regulatory information.

Nuvama Wealth Management Limited

Financial services platform with a multi-business operating model.

Established in 1993 and headquartered in Mumbai’s Bandra Kurla Complex, with businesses spanning wealth, private wealth, asset management, institutional equities, investment banking, asset services and alternatives.
